The image of an ancient ape-man, covered all over with thick brownish hair, retains the typical features of apes on the face (high brow bones, wide and flat nose, thick lips), and has a strong and burly build. Dressed in primitive tribal style clothing: a dress made of brown animal skin (with tassels on the edges), paired with a necklace made of colorful feathers and animal teeth, and arm bands/leg ornaments wrapped in animal skin. Walking the catwalk on the fashion runway creates a visual contrast where "wild and primitive" and "modern and fashionable" collide.
